tool_args.rationale: The target horizon of 24.3 is far beyond the pilot window of 0.16–0.48. A slow-horizon observation is needed to identify the proposed delayed adaptation and distinguish the candidate mechanisms.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five short-horizon observations do not reliably identify the slow component or its long-horizon reversal.
The pilot has s_grad = 0 throughout, leaving its gradient dependence unidentified; the slow-horizon probe is specified to discriminate this mechanism.
Finer short-window measurements are less directly informative about the target horizon.
The short-window observations do not distinguish it reliably from adaptation at the target horizon.
